title: Copy an image file to the system clipboard using xclip
summary: Use xclip to copy an image file (like a PNG) to the system clipboard so you can paste it into image editors or chat applications.

steps.explain: Use the -target flag to specify the image MIME type (e.g., image/png) and copy the file to the clipboard.

placeholders.name: IMAGE_FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the image file (e.g., screenshot.png)

steps.expect: The command runs silently. You can now paste the image in other applications.
